newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-DUTCH STRIKER TAUMENT SIGNS FOR BENFICA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUTCH STRIKER TAUMENT SIGNS FOR BENFICA.

text.p: Dutch international striker Gaston Taument of Feyenoord has signed a four-year contract with Benfica, the Portuguese club said.
Taument, 26, will join the Lisbon club on a free transfer when his contract with the Dutch side expires at the end of the current season.
The player, who signed his new contract on Wednesday, joins fellow Dutchman Glenn Helder at the former European champions who are currently third in the Portuguese league.
